title: Front-camera images are not readable yet
finding: Metadata, calibration and poses for 41 CAM_FRONT frames are integrated; no matching photos were found in the readable folder. The uploaded enhanced.rrd exceeded the 32 MiB transfer limit. The readable overlay.rrd contains incremental layers only.
impact: Current views support geometry reconstruction and the supplied perception recording; correct alignment on camera images remains unverified.
next: Export the 41 CAM_FRONT JPGs from the complete RRD or source dataset, preserving filenames from sample_data; alternatively provide a readable compact camera-media package.
acceptance: Match all 41 images to sample_token, camera timestamps, resolution and calibration; manually inspect normal, occluded and discrepant frames.

title: Reliability is integrated; seven units still lack write evidence
finding: M3 was reproduced and integrated. All seven review units remain Insufficient Evidence, with unknown valid coverage and physical alignment.
impact: High candidate scores, detected-point ratios and algebraic round-trip errors cannot replace reliability evidence.
next: Provide visible, occluded and valid lengths and alignment verification for the same object and frame window; then recompute reliability.
acceptance: Trace non-empty valid coverage to its denominator and source images; reject misaligned and low-coverage examples.

title: Six marking candidates lack verified edit targets
finding: None of the six LD candidates has a verified map-edit target. The nearest map line does not automatically represent the same physical object.
impact: The intended replacement segment is unclear; projection error or a short local observation could overwrite an entire map line.
next: Review LD003 / LD004 first. Deliver target element_id, change type, covered segment and ordered geometry; retain false-detection findings as well.
acceptance: Trace at least one image / perception observation to a unique map target, or explicitly conclude that no edit is warranted.

title: One short scene cannot validate long-term change
finding: scene-0980 contains one visit of about 19.85 seconds and 41 frames. The historical / current role of the reference map is unverified. Duplicate folders are not independent revisits.
impact: Real base-map updates remain zero. A long-term update success rate cannot be reported; controlled writes test the mechanism only.
next: Obtain independent observations of the same road and the baseline-map date. Otherwise limit real-scene conclusions to discrepancy candidates and report controlled trials separately.
acceptance: Verify independent visit_id, actual timestamps, object correspondence and observation periods. Duplicating this clip cannot satisfy revisit thresholds.

title: No validated recommended-route output
finding: The current integration has no executable planner, planning start / goal, planned route or feasibility checks. Existing ego trajectories are recorded paths.
impact: Recorded paths may be projected for inspection; they do not establish a recommended route, obstacle avoidance or improved planning.
next: Deliver structured results containing map version, decision time, start / goal, route_xy, policy, feasible, rejection reason and collision / road-constraint checks.
acceptance: Compare baseline and candidate policies on identical inputs, explicitly report no-route failures and use one traceable route in both views.

title: 217 real-evaluation label rows are empty
finding: Templates contain 29 candidates, 13 behaviors and 175 associations: 217 rows without independent ground truth.
impact: Real precision, recall, F1, false-update rates and planning benefits cannot yet be measured.
next: Choose a minimal evaluation subset covering normal, suspected-change, occluded and mismatched cases. Record annotators, evidence and disagreements; keep labels separate from predictions.
acceptance: Labels must cite evidence rather than copy predictions. Split by scene and keep perturbations of the same scene within one split.

title: High conditional F1 hides many abstentions
finding: Quality gating decides on 36 of 126 variants: 28.6% decision coverage, 94.1% conditional F1 and 22.2% recall over all positives. Variants derive from three windows in the same scene.
impact: Conditional F1 is not overall accuracy; 126 perturbations are not 126 independent real-world scenes.
next: Report coverage, abstentions, conditional metrics and recall over all positives together; add independent calibration / test scenes.
acceptance: Keep proposal, figures and speaking notes consistent; distinguish real data from controlled perturbations.

title: Current aggregate scores use later frames
finding: Multi-frame scores and behavior associations use the full window; the reconstruction also displays the subsequently recorded ego path.
impact: These outputs support retrospective review, but cannot directly serve online planning decisions made before the window ends.
next: Truncate observations at decision time and recompute upstream scores; provide separate online and retrospective interfaces.
acceptance: Decisions must not access future frames. Label retrospective outputs explicitly in the interface and report.

title: Front projection uses offset timestamps and a ground-plane assumption
finding: CAM_FRONT differs from the reference frame by up to 37.609 ms, corresponding to about 0.228 m of ego displacement. Camera-exposure poses are used; the 2D map uses z=0 and object boxes retain annotation-frame timing.
impact: Slopes, occlusion and moving objects can cause image-overlay errors. The reconstruction alone cannot validate physical alignment.
next: Validate static-landmark reprojection on source images and report pixel / metric error; add ground height and temporal interpolation if needed.
acceptance: Report quantitative errors and failure frames, retain unknown regions and clearly identify the reconstruction as synthetic geometry.

title: Original scripts and media packaging hinder reproduction
finding: Original entry points contain old local paths; Windows .cmd files do not run directly on Mac. The repository excludes JPG, MP4 and RRD files. An isolated runner currently supplies explicit paths.
impact: A successful GitHub Desktop sync does not imply that media were uploaded; original scripts may not locate inputs on another machine.
next: Standardize relative paths and CLI inputs; provide dependency versions, small-scene inputs / outputs and media manifests with hashes. Deliver large media separately.
acceptance: Reproduce results in a fresh folder with readable manifest-listed media, without editing hard-coded paths in member source files.

title: The earlier website did not show all promised map-update steps
finding: Slides 2–3 promised before-and-after maps, decision reasons, version history and rollback checks; the earlier website primarily showed candidates and evaluation.
impact: Without an explicit edit workflow, viewers could confuse a visual overlay with a map update.
next: The current site adds real event-layer comparison and engine-driven writes, geometry differences, versions and rollback on a map copy, while retaining the real-write count of zero.
acceptance: Interactively compare before and after, export engine patches and restore original geometry; keep real and controlled statistics separate.
